void:
Usage: rtg [-v | --version] [-language <language>] [-h | --help] [-l | --lang] [-r | --rules] <command> [-l | --lang] [<args>]

The most commonly used rtg commands are:
  image      | Image converter powered by: "RtG-Image".
  preview    | Opens an HTML to view Road to Gramby's JSON build
  --commands  | Show a list of the rtg commands

Use 'rtg help <command> -<language>' for more information on a specific command on your language.
Use 'rtg help <command> -lang' to see the languages of that addon
Use 'rtg --commands' to see the actual internal commands

void-language.es:
Uso: rtg [-v | --version] [-language <idioma>] [-h | --help] [-l | --lang] [-r | --rules] <comando> [-l | --lang] [<args>]

Los comandos de rtg más utilizados son:
  image       | Convertidor de imágenes impulsado por: "RtG-Image".
  preview     | Abre un HTML para ver la construcción JSON de Road to Gramby's
  --commands  | Muestra una lista de los comandos de rtg

Usa 'rtg help <comando> -<idioma>' para más información sobre un comando específico en tu idioma.
Usa 'rtg help <comando> -lang' para ver los idiomas de ese complemento
Usa 'rtg --commands' para ver los comandos internos actuales

JuanCrakYT: Main maintainer and creator of updates

preview.en:
# RtG-Preview
**RtG-Preview** is a lightweight browser-based 3D preview renderer for **RtG-Format** builds.
It allows RtG build data to be rendered interactively in a web browser without requiring a separate application. The renderer is designed to work directly with the existing **[RtG-Format](../README.md)** structure and does not introduce a separate build format.
